title: Apply the national energy retail law fully and keep retail prices deregulated
action: Apply the National Energy Retail Law with minimal state-specific changes in every National Electricity Market jurisdiction, keep retail electricity and gas prices deregulated where competition is effective, and move towards bringing WA and the NT into the national market.
why: One set of rules lets retailers operate nationally at lower cost, and price deregulation lets new retailers compete; state variations and price controls blunt both.

evidence.source: Competition Policy Review: Final Report (Harper review)
evidence.quote: application of the National Energy Retail Law with minimal derogation by all National Electricity Market jurisdictions; • deregulation of both electricity and gas retail prices

tradeoffs: Since 2019 default offers have capped standing offer prices to protect customers who do not switch; the cap should stay at a level that leaves room for competition.
